title: Color from Hex & Resolving Components
hints: Parse the six hex digits with `UInt32(_, radix: 16)` and split channels with shifts and masks.
`Color(.sRGB, red:green:blue:)` builds the color; `resolve(in: EnvironmentValues())` reads it back.
Scale each resolved component by 255 and round.
jsBridge: `Color(hex:)` is a failable extension init that parses `#RRGGBB`. `Color.resolve(in:)` gives the actual components for the current environment (light or dark). CSS parses hex natively; SwiftUI needs you to add it.

compass.q: CSS understands `#ff8800` natively. Why doesn't SwiftUI ship `Color(hex:)`?
Hex colours in code vs asset catalog colours: which supports dark mode and high contrast automatically?
sRGB vs Display P3: can a hex string express P3 colours?
Server-driven theme colours as hex: how do you handle dark mode?
